missing_information: Exact company legal name is not stated beyond the brand name Zavi.
Pricing details beyond the team and enterprise tiers are unclear, including how credits map to each plan over time.
Customer logos are shown, but explicit customer testimonials or named case studies are not provided.
Company maturity is inferred from launch-style copy and pricing, but there is no explicit founded date or funding information.
potential_risks: Some logo rows and repeated UI sections are duplicated in the crawl and should not be overcounted as separate evidence.
The support page URL is labeled about in the source list, but its content is support information; this may indicate a crawl/title mismatch.
Some examples on the homepage are illustrative UI/workflow mockups and should not be treated as confirmed integrations beyond the logos shown.
profile_quality.notes: The crawl provides strong evidence for category, ICP, capabilities, and positioning. The main uncertainty is maturity and the precise commercial packaging beyond a usage-based credits model with team and enterprise tiers.
